fidelity.source_conclusion:
[S1] Compared with previous TN guidelines, there are important changes regarding diagnosis and imaging.
[S2] Carbamazepine is established as effective for controlling pain in patients with TN (multiple Class I and II).
[S3] Surgical discussions should be supported by providing TN patients with written information on the procedures, including details on the possible side effects of surgery
[S4] Recent advances in TN have led to an improvement in its classification on the basis of the neuroimaging findings.
[S5] Evidence-based discussions and decisions are encouraged to establish care pathways for prompt diagnosis and treatment, and long-term outcomes data collection to improve care.
fidelity.fact_fa: از ۳۶ ادعایی که منابع به آن پرداخته‌اند، ۳۶ مورد مطابق است، ۰ مورد تغییر یافته و ۰ مورد برعکس؛ سطح انطباق بالا.
fidelity.interpretation_fa: هر ادعای قابل‌بررسی با دست‌کم یکی از منابع مطابق است.
